titulo: Querer, poder, deber and tener que: Querer and poder

aula.titulo: Querer, poder, deber and tener que
aula.objetivo: Say what you want, can and should do with querer, poder, deber, tener que and hay que; understand stem-changing verbs (e → ie, o → ue); ask for permission, make requests, and decline politely.

itens.pt: to have to, to need to

blocos.titulo: Querer and poder: the vowel that changes
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: you already used «quiero» and «quisiera» in lesson 8. Now you'll see the whole verb. In «querer», whenever the stress falls on the stem, the «e» becomes «ie»: quiero, quieres, quiere, quieren. STEP 2: the same thing happens in «poder» with the «o», which becomes «ue»: puedo, puedes, puede, pueden. STEP 3: the change applies to yo, tú, él/ella/usted and ellos/ustedes. In «nosotros» and «vosotros», the stress falls on the ending, so the stem stays as it is: queremos, queréis; podemos, podéis. Picture a boot shape that covers four forms and leaves two out. STEP 4: «ie» and «ue» are diphthongs — they sound like a single syllable, «KYEH-ro» and «PWEH-do», with the vowels never pulled apart. STEP 5: the infinitive follows «querer» and «poder» directly, with no preposition: «Quiero comer», «Puedo ayudar». STEP 6: «querer» + noun means to want something: «Quiero un café». With a person, it takes «a» (the personal a): «Quiero a mi abuela» means you love her dearly. STEP 7: «poder» expresses possibility, ability and permission. To ask permission: «¿Puedo entrar?». To ask a favor: «¿Puedes repetir?» (tú) or «¿Puede repetir, por favor?» (usted). STEP 8: «poder» isn't the same as «saber»: «Sé nadar» (I learned how to swim) versus «Hoy no puedo nadar» (today, for some reason, I can't / I'm not able to).
blocos.comparacao: English «I want» and «I can» never change their vowel at all, so this is new ground rather than something to transfer. The pattern itself, though, is very regular once you see the «boot» shape: four forms change («quiero, quieres, quiere, quieren» / «puedo, puedes, puede, pueden»), and the two «we/you-all» forms stay exactly like the infinitive stem.

exemplos.pt: We want to travel in the summer.
